title: 40th MDS Legendary 2026 — official LiveTrail results
claims: The official LiveTrail results page linked from the MDS live page lists the 40th MDS Legendary as 270 km with 2,567 m cumulative gain, 1,350 finishers and 85 non-finishers, i.e. 1,435 starters.

The men's overall podium is Mohamed El Morabity 20:47:39, Rachid El Morabity +28:46 and Ludovic Pommeret +31:04; the absolute times for second and third are 21:16:25 and 21:18:43 when the published gaps are added to the winner's time.

The women's overall podium is Maryline Nakache 25:54:29, Aziza El Amrany +3:28:05 and Desiree Linden +4:22:03; the absolute times for second and third are 29:22:34 and 30:16:32 when the published gaps are added to the winner's time.

verification.checkedVia: LiveTrail results page opened from the official MDS live-page ranking link
verification.note: 2026-11-22 从 MDS 官方 live 页的 SEE MORE 外链进入 LiveTrail 2026 总排名页；页面显示 270 KM / 2567 M+ / 1350 完赛 / 85 未完赛，以及男女总排名前三与相对差。绝对成绩是冠军时间加页面相对差，未替换页面原始值。

claimVerification.note: LiveTrail 2026 页顶部：270 KM、2567 M+、完赛者 1350、未完赛 85；两者相加 1,435。
